description: This file defines custom composable button components (NiaButton, NiaOutlinedButton, NiaTextButton) for Android using Jetpack Compose, wrapping Material 3 button components with additional styling and content slots. It also includes preview functions and default styling constants.

classes.name: NiaButtonDefaults
classes.description: Object holding default styling constants for custom buttons, such as border width and disabled border alpha.

methods.name: NiaButton
methods.description: Composable function for a filled button with customizable content slot, wrapping Material 3 Button.

methods.name: NiaButton (overload with text and icon)
methods.description: Composable function for a filled button with text and optional leading icon.

methods.name: NiaOutlinedButton
methods.description: Composable function for an outlined button with customizable content slot, wrapping Material 3 OutlinedButton.

methods.name: NiaOutlinedButton (overload with text and icon)
methods.description: Composable function for an outlined button with text and optional leading icon.

methods.name: NiaTextButton
methods.description: Composable function for a text button with customizable content slot, wrapping Material 3 TextButton.

methods.name: NiaTextButton (overload with text and icon)
methods.description: Composable function for a text button with text and optional leading icon.

methods.name: NiaButtonContent
methods.description: Internal composable for arranging button text and leading icon.
